rationale: Positives: The agent authenticated the user via matching email, used read-only tools to retrieve gift card balance and the user’s recent order details, correctly identified the card used (Mastercard ending 4336), confirmed the exact change before modifying a pending order’s payment method, and successfully executed the change to Visa (ending 8902). These actions align with policy. Issue: After modifying the payment, the agent stated that the previous Mastercard charge “will be refunded within 5 to 7 business days.” The tool output did not show a refund transaction or any refund timeline, so this statement is unsupported/fabricated per policy. The claim about not being able to combine payment methods is plausible given available tools, but the explicit refund timeline is not substantiated. Because the agent introduced unsupported information, the interaction fails the pass bar despite otherwise correct handling.
